parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by a field of force.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
An isolated planet may be assumed to be a uniform sphere of radius $3.39 \times 10^6\text{ m}$ with its mass of $6.42 \times 10^{23}\text{ kg}$ concentrated at its centre.

Calculate the gravitational field strength at the surface of the planet.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Calculate the height above the surface of the planet in (b) at which the gravitational field strength is $1.0\%$ less than its value at the surface of the planet.
